final: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS avg_line_cost, AVG(inv.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(inv.ratio) - (SELECT avg_ratio FROM overall) AS excess_over_overall FROM inv WHERE inv.ratio > (SELECT avg_ratio FROM overall)
